newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Praxair EPS view raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Praxair EPS view raised.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said Thursday it had increased its earnings estimates on Praxair Inc to $2.09 a share from $2.06 for 1996, and to $2.65 from $2.60 for 1997. It also set a preliminary 1998 estimate of $3.10 a share.
-- EVEREN said Praxair's third quarter earnings of $0.54 a share exceeded EVEREN's estimate by $0.02.
-- It increased its intermediate six-month price objective on the company's stock to $52 from $42, and its six- to 18-month target to $60 from $50.
